tools.name: find_referral_code
tools.description: Returns the verified referral code or referral link for one app (e.g. 'Underdog', 'Kling AI', 'Novig', 'Courtside', 'Muse'), with the exact field and moment to enter it, the sign-up destination and whether it carries the referral, the new user benefit, the steps, the conditions, and the verification

tools.name: list_referral_offers
tools.description: Lists every active referral offer (app, code, sign-up link, what the new user gets, verification date), optionally filtered by category: 'ai', 'sports', 'money' or 'all'.
